blocks.text: Day 8  ·  After breakfast, sightseeing tour with an English-speaking guide, beginning in the city centre at La Moneda, a historic monument built in neoclassical style in the last years of Spanish rule to house the royal mint and, since the mid-19th century, the seat of the Chilean government. Continue to the Plaza de Armas, where the history of the city began, surrounded by the Governor’s House, the City Hall, the Central Post Office, the Royal Audience building and the Cathedral. Then transfer to the airport for your flight home. End of services.
